title.narrative: Advancing Gender Equality and Economic Justice through Inclusive Cooperatives

description.narrative:
The intersection of sustainable livelihoods and gender equality offers a powerful pathway for advancing development and human rights in Kenya. For women—especially women human rights defenders (WHRDs)—secure, dignified livelihoods are essential for sustained civic and political engagement. Strengthening cooperatives with gender-responsive governance and business-and-human-rights safeguards can transform them into platforms for women's economic empowerment and leadership. Amid a rapidly shrinking civic space, WHRDs face gendered risks that threaten their activism. Economic resilience, psychosocial well-being, and strong feminist networks are therefore critical. By integrating femtorship and leadership development into livelihood initiatives, the project addresses both material needs and the structural barriers that limit women's participation and voice. The Hub, serving as a gender technical partner to We Effect's programs, will provide tailored gender mainstreaming support to ensure that cooperative and livelihood initiatives are inclusive and rights-based. Strengthening its own pillars—livelihoods, femtorship, safety, and well-being—The Hub will model feminist leadership and movement-building.
The project is justified by its alignment with donor priorities (gender equality, business and human rights, sustainable livelihoods), its focus on addressing structural gaps like economic precarity and shrinking civic space, and its ability to leverage institutional expertise while innovating through cooperative support and multimedia advocacy. It contributes directly to SDGs 5, 8, and 10, while promoting democratic participation and social justice.
